'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]], [[Russia–NATO relations]]
***The [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office]] says that, according to the available information, the Russian government is planning to "install a pro-Russian leader in Kyiv as it considers whether to invade and occupy Ukraine." [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/01/22/europe/bulgaria-romania-russia-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***Vice Admiral [[Kay-Achim Schönbach]] resigns as [[Inspector of the Navy|Inspector of the German Navy]] following comments at a think tank in [[New Delhi]], in which he called Russia's intention to attack Ukraine "nonsense", saying that [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] "deserves respect" and dismissing the prospects of Ukraine ever regaining [[Crimea]] and joining [[NATO]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/23/german-navy-chief-quits-after-saying-putin-deserves-respect-over-ukraine (''The Guardian'')]  

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports its first confirmed deaths related to the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in an unvaccinated 64-year-old man and a [[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia|vaccinated]] 54-year-old woman who both had underlying health conditions. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20220122190036-20-750004/2-kasus-kematian-omicron-di-indonesia-gejala-berat-dan-lansia (CNN Indonesia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 54,576 new [[COVID-19]] cases, including a record 11,227 new cases in [[Tokyo]] and a record 7,675 new cases in [[Osaka Prefecture]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2022/01/c1ced975d81e-urgent-tokyos-daily-covid-19-cases-top-10000-for-1st-time-hit-record-high.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports its first confirmed death related to the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in an unvaccinated 92-year-old woman. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/unvaccinated-woman-92-first-omicron-related-death-in-singapore (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 40,876 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4,484,095. [https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2888884,Poland-reports-another-daily-record-with-40876-COVID19-cases (Polskie Radio)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****Romania surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/romania-a-depasit-pragul-de-2-milioane-de-infectati-de-la-debutul-pandemiei-capitala-si-28-de-judete-sunt-in-scenariul-rosu-1811833 (Digi24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 57,212 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11.04 million. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russia-sees-record-covid-19-cases-second-day-running/articleshow/89057996.cms (''The Times of India'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kiribati]]
****[[Kiribati]] goes into lockdown for the first time during the pandemic after dozens of passengers onboard a January 14th [[charter flight]] from [[Fiji]] test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/kiribati-lockdown-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa]]
****[[Samoa]] Prime Minister [[Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa]] announces a three day lockdown in response to ten positive COVID-19 passengers from repatriation flight. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/459986/samoa-announces-lockdown-from-6pm-tonight-until-6pm-on-monday (RNZ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Solomon Islands]]
****The number of new COVID-19 cases rises to 48, despite ongoing lockdowns in [[Ontong Java Atoll]], [[Honiara]], and [[Guadalcanal Province]]. The current outbreak began last week when 23 crew members onboard an [[illegal fishing]] vessel from [[Papua New Guinea]] tested positive after entering [[Ontong Java Atoll]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/459915/covid-numbers-soar-in-solomons (RNZ)]
